title: Eggplant Delicate Italian Tempeh Lasagna
description: A creamy, rich lasagna featuring tender tempeh, rich eggplant, and fresh basil, all baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven.
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1/4-inch thick rounds and season with salt.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, blend together the tomato sauce, garlic, dried oregano, and nutritional yeast.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the tempeh to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked tempeh, blended tomato sauce, and chopped fresh basil.
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, create a thin layer of tomato sauce.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, followed by a layer of the tempeh mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of tomato sauce and vegan mozzarella cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
